entry.title: Switzerland Train Pass & Camping Trip - 2021: Day Nine – Lausanne
entry.summary: Photos from my 11 day trip to Switzerland in the Autumn of…
entry.content:
Photos from my 11 day trip to Switzerland in the Autumn of 2021.

Day nine and my last full day in Switzerland and as the weather was a bit off today I took a walk around Lausanne and discovered that my covid pass I have from England is not recognised in Switzerland,  just the day before the country had put in tighter restrictions and now to visit museums/ exhibitions or eat in restaurants the new Euro pass was required so my options where a bit limited but as it was the end of my trip I was not too bothered and enjoyed checking out a spot by Lake Geneva that I have visited on two other past trips to Lausanne! – enjoy the photos! 🙂

entry.title: Switzerland Train Pass & Camping Trip - 2021: Day Eight – Evian, South-East France
entry.summary: Photos from my 11 day trip to Switzerland in the Autumn of…
entry.content:
Photos from my 11 day trip to Switzerland in the Autumn of 2021.

Day eight and wake up in the nice comfy bed of my hotel room after 7 nights of camping outside, I have two days to explore in Lausanne and this first day I catch a ferry over to Evian (Évian-les-Bains) in France, it takes about 30 mins to cross Lake Geneva (Lac Léman), and check I out the town and it’s classic funicular that was recently restored! – enjoy the photos! 🙂

entry.title: Switzerland Train Pass & Camping Trip - 2021: Day Seven – Gruyeres – Part Two – H. R. Giger Museum (Inc. 4K Video)
entry.summary: Photos and video from my 11 day trip to Switzerland in the…
entry.content:
Photos and video from my 11 day trip to Switzerland in the Autumn of 2021.

Day seven and I travel to the Swiss French town of Gruyeres leaving Interlaken and the camping part of my trip, I visited this medieval town en-route to my final destination of Lausanne.

What enticed me to the charming town Gruyeres was not only the beautiful location in the Swiss countryside but also the idea of visiting the one and only Swiss surrealist painter, sculptor and set designer HR Giger’s museum and Giger bar, a permanent repository of his work!

Under the late Giger’s wishes, photography and filming was not allowed inside the exhibition (that has now been permanently burned into my brain! 😉 ) but I was allowed to photograph the shop area and the sculptures outside the Saint-Germain Castle that was brought by Giger to house the museum and the bar  – enjoy the photos! 🙂

Photos and video from my 11 day trip to Switzerland in the Autumn of 2021.

entry.title: Switzerland Train Pass & Camping Trip - 2021: Day Four – Lugano (Inc. 4K Video)
entry.summary: Photos and video from my 11 day trip to Switzerland in the…
entry.content:
Photos and video from my 11 day trip to Switzerland in the Autumn of 2021.

Day four and today the weather takes a turn for the worst! after a rainy nights camping I awake to more rain in Interlaken and decide that as I’ve got the Swiss Travel Pass I would travel quite a distance to the Italian Swiss town of Lugano – the climate there is more of a sunny one for sure!

It takes an average of 4h 42m to travel from Interlaken West to Lugano by train, over a distance of around 70 miles (113 km) so I brought my lunch on the train with me! – enjoy the photos! 🙂

entry.summary: Photos from my 11 day trip to Switzerland in the Autumn of…
entry.content:
Photos from my 11 day trip to Switzerland in the Autumn of 2021.

Day three and I travel to the Swiss central city of Lucerne (or Luzern) where I admire the handy work of the 14th century Chapel Bridge, explore the old town and walk the old fortifications, this is my third visit to the city and it still has it’s charms! – enjoy the photos! 🙂

entry.title: Switzerland Train Pass & Camping Trip - 2021: Day Two – The Schilthorn, Piz Gloria, 007 & Lauterbrunnen (Inc. 4K Video)
entry.summary: Photos and video from my 11 day trip to Switzerland in the…
entry.content:
Photos and video from my 11 day trip to Switzerland in the Autumn of 2021.

Day two and as the weather is holding up nicely I decide to tackle my next big destination today – the summit of the Schilthorn! made famous for being the film location for the iconic Bond movie “On Her Majesty’s Secret Service” which was released in 1969 and has very interesting story behind how it happened.

To reach the Schilthorn and Piz Gloria (the 360-degree revolving restaurant that sits on top of the summit) I took a train from Interlaken to Stechelberg then took a series of five cable cars to reach the summit, the whole journey was full of eye watering scenery! enjoy the photos! 🙂
